# Signal Loom concept note
Date: 1 February 2026

## Original intention
The initial aim was a small installation where turning a rotary dial would make a projected ribbon follow the visitor's speed.

## Early design
The first design used a glass screen and a rotary dial. These were prototype choices, not requirements for every later version.

## Initial practical concern
Reflections on the glass made the ribbon difficult to see. This observation came from a bench setup by the fictional maker, not from a visitor or tutor.
